title: Bardchló
description: Gaelic typeface for Minecraft, inspired by Mojangles and Petrie.
body:
Gaelic typeface for Minecraft, inspired by Mojangles and Petrie. Bitmap font created using https://www.pentacom.jp/pentacom/bitfontmaker2/. The Gaelchló site (https://gaelchlo.com/) was also very useful when undertaking this project.

This resource pack is designed for working with Gaelic languages in Minecraft, *not* as a "Celtic" style font to be used in English; the font will be difficult to read for English speakers. Character set covers ASCII, Irish (standardised orthography and pre-reform, with overdots), Scottish Gaelic and Manx.

This resource pack changes the in-game font, but does not change the in-game language or spelling of words. Irish and Scottish Gaelic are already available in-game. To play in Irish spelt in the pre-reform spelling, with overdots in the in-game strings, you will need to use DinneenCraft (coming soon).
